answer.text: The warning symbol lights up whenever a vehicle component develops a fault.
The manual does not say which specific part has failed.
Consult your Royal Enfield Authorised Service Centre about any problem that occurs in the operation of the motorcycle.

watchout_review.reason: Concerns the engine MIL and EMS malfunctions, not the general warning symbol.
Concerns loading weight and fitting accessories.
Continuation of E26 on nonstandard parts.
Concerns model and design specifications for accessories.
Concerns nonstandard front forks and suspensions.
Concerns running-in of a new motorcycle.
Concerns riding at moderate speeds while learning the bike.
Concerns inspecting shock absorbers and front forks for leaks.
Concerns hazard flashing and battery strain.

disclaimers.text: The manual does not identify which specific component has failed when the warning symbol is on.
